title: Planday Alternatives: 7 Best Picks for 2026
summary: Paying per user for Planday adds up fast. Compare 7 Planday alternatives with 2026 pricing, G2 and Capterra ratings, and free plan options.
body_markdown:
If you’re searching for Planday alternatives, you probably want one of three things: a lower bill, a free plan, or a tool built for US hourly teams. This guide compares seven Planday alternatives, all employee scheduling software for small business, on what they cost at 10, 25, and 50 employees, how their free plans work, and what real users say on G2 and Capterra.


## **Planday Alternatives at a Glance: The Short Answer**


The best Planday alternative depends on how you want to pay: per location, per team, or per user. These five Planday alternatives cover most small US teams:


- **Homebase:** free for up to 10 employees, then one flat price per location.
- **Findmyshift:** one flat price per team, starting at $27 a month.
- **Deputy:** built-in labor law compliance, from $5 per user.
- **When I Work:** simple mobile scheduling, from $2.50 per user.
- **7shifts:** restaurant tools, free for up to 15 employees.


### Build your team schedule in minutes.


[Try Homebase free](https://app.joinhomebase.com/onboarding/sign-up)


## **Why Trust Homebase? Why We Built This Guide to Planday Alternatives**


We’re Homebase, and we make an app for small businesses with hourly teams. The app covers scheduling, a time clock, team messaging, hiring, and payroll in one place, and more than 150,000 small businesses use it.


We wrote this guide to Planday alternatives for owners who picked Planday for the low per-user price and then hit the seat minimums. Starter needs five users, Plus needs 10 plus a $15.00 monthly fee, and neither plan is free.


That gives us a point of view worth naming up front. We charge per location and offer a free plan for one location and up to 10 employees, the two things Planday doesn’t. Every Planday alternative in this guide was judged on its own merits, and we never accept payment or backlinks for a mention.


### **What Homebase offers as employee scheduling software for teams leaving Planday.**


Planday Plus users shopping for a Planday alternative lean on leave management, payroll reporting, and team communication. Our Plus plan covers the same ground at $70 per location: PTO and time-off controls, an AI-powered Scheduling Assistant, departments and permissions, and team communication tools that start on Essentials. Payroll is an add-on, and the free Basic plan handles one location and up to 10 employees.


### **How per-location pricing shapes our view of Planday alternatives.**


A per-location price stays flat as your team grows, but it climbs with every address you add. Planday pricing does the opposite, because it’s cheap for five people and expensive for 50. We lean toward flat pricing, so we compare every Planday alternative at 10, 25, and 50 employees and flag where per-user pricing wins. You’ll find that math in the cost comparison below.


## **How We Chose the Best Planday Alternatives and Shift Scheduling Software**


We picked seven Planday alternatives that are priced in US dollars and sold to US small businesses, so each one works as shift scheduling software and scheduling software for small business, then compared them against Planday’s own tiers. Our[methodology page](https://www.joinhomebase.com/methodology) explains how we review tools across every guide we publish.


### **Criteria we used to compare Planday alternatives for US teams.**


Each Planday alternative had to cover what a Planday Starter or Plus user already relies on: scheduling, time tracking, compliance warnings, team communication, and leave management on Plus. From there, we compared five things:


- **Price at three team sizes:** what each alternative to Planday costs at 10, 25, and 50 employees.
- **Free plan limits:** how many employees or users the free plan covers and what it leaves out.
- **Pricing shape:** whether the tool charges per user, per team, per location, or per hub.
- **US support:** whether support hours work for teams in US time zones.
- **User ratings:** G2 and Capterra scores, plus how many reviews sit behind them.


### **How we verified pricing and ratings for Planday alternatives.**


We read every price from the vendor’s own pricing page on November 2, 2026, and pulled ratings and review text from G2 and Capterra the same day. We also read an[r/smallbusiness thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/smallbusiness/comments/1refwrc/best_free_scheduling_app_for_employees_what/) about free scheduling apps, and we skipped replies from vendor employees and founders. Nobody on our team ran first-person demos, so everything we say about each Planday alternative rests on pricing pages, published reviews, and community discussion.


### **Which Planday alternatives we left out.**


We cut a few Planday competitors so the list of Planday alternatives fits US small businesses:


- **Nowsta, Shiftboard, and Quinyx:** built for large organizations, and Nowsta lists a starting price of $18,000 a year on Capterra.
- **Shiftbase:** priced only in euros and pounds, with mostly European integrations.
- **TimeForge:** aimed at restaurant chains rather than small teams.


## **Top Three Planday Alternatives Compared**


Pricing for these top three Planday alternatives comes from each vendor’s pricing page as of November 2, 2026.


Top Three Planday Alternatives Compared **Homebase** **Findmyshift** **Deputy**


**Price** Free; $30, $70, or $120 per location per month Free for five team members; $27, $43, or $85 per team per month $5, $6.50, or $9 per user per month on annual billing


**Setup time** Self-serve sign-up, no credit card; G2 reviewers call setup easy Under one month on G2; reviewers call setup easy Self-serve onboarding on Lite; paid onboarding on annual plans, with account size limits


**Free tier** Basic: one location, up to 10 employees Free: five team members, one manager None; free trial


**Key integrations** 18 listed on G2 18 on G2, including Google Workspace, Clover, and Lightspeed Retail Payroll and HR integrations on every plan


**Best for** Hourly teams that want a free start and flat pricing Tiny teams that want the basics Teams that need labor law compliance and forecasting


## **How Homebase Compares to Planday as Scheduling Software for Small Business**


### **Planday vs Homebase pricing: per user vs per location.**


Planday vs Homebase comes down to how each one charges for growth. Planday pricing charges for every person on your schedule. Our pricing follows the number of locations instead, which makes Homebase a flat-priced Planday alternative: a bigger team doesn’t raise the bill. Planday Starter costs less than a $30 Essentials plan only under 11 users, and When I Work only under 12, while our free Basic plan covers up to 10 employees at one location.


Here’s what a 25-person and a 50-person team pay each month on monthly billing for Planday and each Planday alternative. The plans aren’t identical, so treat this as a price comparison, not a feature match.


Planday vs Homebase pricing: per user vs per location. **Tool and plan** **How it charges** **25 employees** **50 employees**


Planday Starter Per user, five-user minimum $74.75 $149.50


Planday Plus Per user plus $15.00 monthly fee, 10-user minimum $127.25 $239.50


When I Work Essentials Per user $62.50 $125


Deputy Lite Per user, monthly billing $137.50 $275


Findmyshift Per team $43 (Business) $43 (Business)


Connecteam Operations Basic Per hub, first 30 users $35 $55


7shifts Per location, monthly billing $44.99 (Essentials) $89.99 (Pro)


Sling Premium Per user Free (up to 30 users) $100


Homebase Per location $30 (Essentials) or $70 (Plus) $30 (Essentials) or $70 (Plus)


At 10 employees, Planday Starter costs $29.90, while Homebase Basic, Connecteam’s Small Business Plan, Sling’s free plan, and 7shifts’ Comp plan all cost $0. Findmyshift’s Starter plan runs $27. That’s the pattern with Planday pricing per user: it climbs with every hire.


“We save time, and we save labor costs. I’d say we saved about 20% of our labor budget because of how much more efficient it made things.” Calvin Su, Owner,[Butter Baker](https://www.joinhomebase.com/customers/butter-baker-case-study-scheduling-labor-costs)


Paying per head means every new hire raises your bill. A flat per-location price keeps the monthly cost predictable, and the free Basic plan covers a team of 10 at $0 (see how[Homebase pricing](https://www.joinhomebase.com/pricing) works).


### **Planday vs Homebase scheduling tools for small teams.**


Planday Starter includes scheduling, simple time tracking, working time rules with compliance warnings, basic payroll reporting, and team communication. Plus adds advanced scheduling, leave and absence management, payroll integrations, revenue reporting, and employee document management.


Here’s what our app offers as a Planday alternative, by plan:


- **Basic (free):** scheduling, basic time tracking, and point-of-sale integration.
- **Essentials ($30 per location):** employees trade, cover, and claim open shifts, with location-based clock-in, custom overtime and break preferences, automatic reminders, and team communication tools.
- **Plus ($70 per location):** PTO and time-off controls, an AI-powered Scheduling Assistant, and departments and permissions.


Ruru Baked builds a full month of shifts at a time on our Essentials plan.


“Could you plan out an entire month of a schedule in Excel or on Post-it notes or on a whiteboard? Probably not. With Homebase we can do that, and then you can change it easily.” Luanne Ronquillo, Owner & Founder,[Ruru Baked](https://www.joinhomebase.com/customers/ruru-baked-case-study-scheduling)


### **Switching from Planday to Homebase with multi-location scheduling software.**


Per-location pricing rewards teams with big crews at a few addresses. Three locations with 15 employees each cost $90 a month on Essentials, compared with $134.55 on Planday Starter. The cost rises with every location you add, so a business with many small sites should run the numbers before moving to any Planday alternative. Our[multi-location scheduling software](https://www.joinhomebase.com/employee-scheduling/multi-location-scheduling) shows every location in one view.


“I like how you can see two locations at once on the scheduling side. The location you’re not editing will be grayed out.” Fred Sztabinski, Owner,[Fix Coffee + Bikes](https://www.joinhomebase.com/customers/fix-coffee-bikes-case-study-scheduling)


## **Best Planday Alternatives for Small Business: Ranked Employee Scheduling Apps**


These seven alternatives to Planday are ranked on price shape, free plan limits, and fit for US hourly teams, so you can compare each Planday alternative side by side.


### **Homebase: Best free alternative to Planday for hourly teams.**


Our pick among Planday alternatives for teams ready to leave per-user billing behind: the free Basic plan covers one location and up to 10 employees, and paid plans add unlimited employees for one flat price per location. Scheduling and a time clock come with every plan, team communication joins on Essentials, and payroll is an optional add-on.


**Best for:** small teams with hourly employees that want free employee scheduling software and flat pricing.


**Rating:** G2[4.6](https://www.g2.com/products/homebase/reviews) (648 reviews) · Capterra[4.6](https://www.capterra.com/p/153076/Homebase/reviews/) (1,147 reviews)


**What it is:** An all-in-one app for hourly teams,[Homebase](https://www.joinhomebase.com/) covers scheduling, time tracking, team messaging, hiring, and optional payroll.


**Key features:**


- **Free Basic plan:** scheduling, basic time tracking, and point-of-sale integration for one location.
- **Shift trading:** employees trade, cover, and claim open shifts on Essentials and above.
- **Time off and scheduling help:** PTO controls and an AI-powered Scheduling Assistant on Plus.
- **Payroll add-on:** a $49 monthly base fee plus $6 per employee paid, available on any plan.


**Pricing:** Basic is free for one location and up to 10 employees. Paid plans charge per location with unlimited employees: Essentials is $30, Plus is $70, and All-in-One is $120 per month, with annual billing advertised at about 20 percent off. A free 14-day trial of All-in-One needs no credit card, and your account drops to Basic if you don’t pick a plan.


**What users like:** An owner[wrote on G2](https://g2.com/products/homebase/reviews?page=2) that the app “has become an important part of how we run our business.”


“It was super easy to work with. Never having scheduled people before, never having used that kind of software, I was able to figure it out and customize a lot of features that really helped us establish our team from the beginning.” Anna Saltino, Co-owner,[Gusto Bread](https://www.joinhomebase.com/customers/gusto-bread-case-study-scheduling)


**What users criticize:** A vice president at a small business[named](https://www.g2.com/products/homebase/reviews) “the price for the full or advance features” as the downside. G2 reviewers also tag limited customization as a theme, with 19 mentions.


**Our take:** Payroll costs extra, and Basic stores timesheets for 90 days, so teams that need longer history should start on Essentials. The free plan stops at 10 employees and one location. Past that, the price follows your locations, which works best for crews that cluster at a few addresses. Try our[free scheduling app](https://www.joinhomebase.com/free-scheduling) before you decide on a Planday alternative.


### **Findmyshift: Best simple Planday alternative for teams of 20 or fewer.**


Findmyshift charges per team instead of per employee, which makes it a bargain Planday alternative for a crew of 20 or fewer that needs scheduling and time clocking. A free plan covers five team members, and Starter runs $27 a month for up to 20. Once you need more than 100 team members, Enterprise is $85.


**Best for:** tiny teams that want a flat monthly price and a simple schedule.


**Rating:** G2[4.7](https://www.g2.com/products/out-crowd-ltd-findmyshift/reviews) (33 reviews) · Capterra[4.6](https://www.capterra.com/p/115536/Findmyshift/reviews/) (1,180+ reviews)


**What it is:** A cloud scheduling tool,[Findmyshift](https://www.findmyshift.com/) offers drag-and-drop shifts, timesheets, shift reminders, and mobile apps for managers and employees.


**Key features:**


- **Per-team pricing:** one flat price covers 20, 100, or 300 team members.
- **Free plan:** five team members and one manager, with one week of forward planning.
- **Time clocking and timesheets:** employees submit their hours for manager approval.
- **Integrations:** G2 lists 18, including Google Workspace, Clover, and Lightspeed Retail.


**Pricing:** The free plan covers five team members. Starter is $27 a month, or $24 billed yearly, for 20 team members and one manager. Business is 43(38 yearly) for 100 team members, and Enterprise is 85(75 yearly) for 300. A three-month free trial gives full access, and prices are in USD.


**What users like:** A small-business reviewer[called it](https://www.g2.com/products/out-crowd-ltd-findmyshift/reviews) “a simple, very easy-to-use, and friendly application.”


**What users criticize:** Some G2 reviewers find editing harder on the mobile app than on the web, and one health care reviewer says the upgraded plans are hard to justify for a smaller business. A[Capterra reviewer](https://www.capterra.com/p/115536/Findmyshift/reviews/?page=2) said the jump from the free plan left a team of seven to 10 people with “no viable option,” though that review quotes an older $46 price and Starter now costs $27.


**Our take:** Support is the catch for US teams considering this Planday alternative. Findmyshift lists live chat from 12am to 10pm GMT and phone support from 6am to 10pm GMT, Monday through Friday, with a US phone line and a 24-hour email goal. In winter, live support ends around 5pm Eastern, or 2pm Pacific, and there’s no live support on weekends. The free plan’s one-week planning window also limits how far ahead you can schedule.


### **Deputy: Best Planday alternative for compliance and labor forecasting.**


Deputy is the Planday alternative for teams that need labor law compliance and forecasting built into the schedule. Plans run $5 to $9 per user per month on annual billing, and Core adds auto-scheduling and demand forecasting. Planday vs Deputy comes down to depth, since Deputy offers more compliance and forecasting tools while its per-user bill grows with every hire.


**Best for:** teams that need built-in labor law compliance and forecasting.


**Rating:** G2[4.5](https://www.g2.com/products/deputy/reviews) (888 reviews) · Capterra[4.6](https://www.capterra.com/p/167811/Deputy/reviews/) (772 reviews)


**What it is:** From Deputy Corporation,[Deputy](https://deputy.com/) is a team management app for scheduling, time clocking, leave, and messaging, with optional HR and payroll add-ons.


**Key features:**


- **Lite:** basic scheduling, timesheets, time clocking, labor law compliance, shift swaps, and leave management.
- **Core:** auto-scheduling, demand forecasting, labor budgets, and biometric time clocking.
- **Pro:** custom access levels, location hierarchies, single sign-on, and 24/7 live chat.
- **Add-ons:** HR, Messaging+, Analytics+, and payroll through Paycor.


**Pricing:** Annual billing runs $5 for Lite, $6.50 for Core, and $9 for Pro per user per month, and monthly billing is $5.50, $7.25, and $10, all in USD before taxes. Pro requires a call with sales. HR costs $2 per user, Messaging+ is $1.95, and Analytics+ is $1.50, with the last two included in Pro. Payroll by Paycor adds $8 per user plus a $49 monthly base fee on annual Core and Pro plans in the US, and Deputy says the fees vary by business size. A free trial is available.


**What users like:** A mid-market reviewer[called Deputy](https://www.g2.com/products/deputy/reviews?qs=pros-and-cons) “extremely user friendly” for clocking in, adding leave, and correcting time.


**What users criticize:** G2 counts 27 mentions of clock-in problems, such as the app freezing or failing to read a location. Reviewers also say tier changes can feel like forced upgrades.


**Our take:** Deputy suits teams that will use its compliance and forecasting tools. If you only need schedules and a time clock, a lighter Planday alternative won’t charge you for depth you don’t use. Deputy lists fair workweek compliance, and our guide to[predictive scheduling laws](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/predictive-scheduling-laws) explains the rules. For a closer look, read our[Homebase vs Deputy](https://www.joinhomebase.com/compare/homebase-vs-deputy) comparison or our[Deputy alternatives](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/deputy-alternatives) guide.


### **When I Work: Best shift scheduling app for mobile-first teams.**


A low entry price and a mobile-first design make When I Work a natural next stop among Planday alternatives. Essentials starts at $2.50 per user per month and includes auto scheduling, multi-location scheduling, templates, OpenShifts, and shift swapping. There’s no free plan, but a 14-day trial lets you test it first.


**Best for:** mobile-first teams that want simple scheduling at a low per-user price.


**Rating:** G2[4.4](https://www.g2.com/products/when-i-work/reviews) (418 reviews) · Capterra[4.5](https://www.capterra.com/p/121248/When-I-Work/reviews/) (1,300 reviews)


**What it is:** A scheduling and time clock app,[When I Work](https://wheniwork.com/) adds team messaging and payroll and point-of-sale integrations.


**Key features:**


- **Essentials:** unlimited users, schedule templates, forecast tools, in-app messaging, OpenShifts, and shift swapping.
- **Pro:** scheduling rules, role permissions, labor sharing, and custom reporting.
- **Premium:** API key access, webhooks, and single sign-on.
- **Time tracking:** a toggle on each plan; the pricing page doesn’t say whether it costs extra.


**Pricing:** Essentials is $2.50, Pro is $5, and Premium is $8 per user per month. There’s no free plan, and the 14-day trial needs no credit card. The pricing page’s FAQ says multi-location teams pay $5 per user, so check which plan covers your second location before you commit.


**What users like:** A center director[called it](https://www.g2.com/survey_responses/when-i-work-review-7333232) “user-friendly and efficient” for schedules and communication.


**What users criticize:** A clinician manager[found the mobile app](https://www.g2.com/survey_responses/when-i-work-review-5349009) “difficult to navigate” when juggling multiple roles. G2 reviewers also tag scheduling issues in 15 reviews and missing features in 10.


**Our take:** When I Work starts at $2.50 per user, above Sling’s $2.00 Premium plan but below Planday and Deputy. The pricing page shows a time tracking toggle on each plan, yet its FAQ says every plan includes time and attendance, so confirm what that costs before you commit. Per-user pricing also grows with your team, so this Planday alternative suits smaller crews best. At 25 employees you’d pay $62.50 a month on Essentials. Our[When I Work alternatives](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/wheniwork-alternatives) guide goes deeper.


### **7shifts: Best restaurant scheduling software Planday alternative.**


Restaurants get the most from 7shifts, a Planday alternative and restaurant scheduling software built for food service. The free Comp plan covers up to 15 employees at one location, and paid plans charge per location instead of per employee. Tip management, task management, a manager log book, and payroll sit on the higher tiers, and you can also buy some of them as add-ons.


**Best for:** restaurants, bars, and cafes that want tools made for food service.


**Rating:** G2[4.5](https://www.g2.com/products/7shifts/reviews) (128 reviews) · Capterra[4.7](https://www.capterra.com/p/123038/7shifts-Restaurant-Scheduling/reviews/) (1,211 reviews)


**What it is:** A restaurant scheduling and team management app,[7shifts](https://www.7shifts.com/) includes time clocking, labor compliance tools, and optional payroll.


**Key features:**


- **Comp:** basic scheduling, announcements, and availability and time-off requests.
- **Essentials:** advanced scheduling, team messaging, basic time clocking, and permissions.
- **Pro:** PTO tracking, labor compliance and labor cost tools, and a manager log book.
- **Premium:** tip management, task management, payroll, and employee training.


**Pricing:** Prices are per location per month. On annual billing, Comp is free for up to 15 employees, Essentials is $39.99 for up to 30, Pro is $79.99 for up to 60, and Premium is $134.99 for unlimited employees. Monthly billing runs $44.99, $89.99, and $149.99. Payroll adds $39.99 plus 6peremployeepaid,andPremiumincludesitintheUS.Tipmanagement(49.99), task management (12.99),andthemanagerlogbook(14.99) are also sold as monthly add-ons per location. A 14-day trial is available.


**What users like:** A small-business reviewer on G2 calls it user friendly and says it covers everything their business needs.


**What users criticize:** One reviewer[wrote](https://www.g2.com/products/7shifts/reviews?page=2) “Admin interface is clunky, and the price has gone up.”


**Our take:** If you don’t run a restaurant, tools like tip management won’t matter to you and a general Planday alternative will fit better. Prices also jump with each tier. Our guide to the[best restaurant scheduling apps](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/best-restaurant-scheduling-software) covers the category, and our[7shifts alternatives](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/7shifts-alternatives) post compares other options.


### **Connecteam: Best Planday alternative for field and mobile teams.**


Field and mobile teams that want scheduling, a time clock, forms, and team chat in one app will like Connecteam as a Planday alternative. A free Small Business Plan covers up to 10 users across all hubs, and paid plans cover the first 30 users for one flat monthly price. Costs climb quickly once you add more hubs.


**Best for:** field and mobile teams under 30 users that want a time clock with GPS.


**Rating:** G2[4.6](https://www.g2.com/products/connecteam/reviews) (3,505 reviews) · Capterra[4.6](https://www.capterra.com/p/153140/Connecteam/reviews/) (5,000+ reviews)


**What it is:** An all-in-one employee management app,[Connecteam](https://connecteam.com/) splits its tools into separate hubs for operations, communications, and HR.


**Key features:**


- **Operations Hub:** a time clock with GPS, job scheduling with open shifts, forms, and quick tasks.
- **Advanced:** auto clock-out and up to 10 geofence sites.
- **Expert:** auto-assigned shifts, unlimited geofence sites, and API access.
- **Small Business Plan:** all hubs, free for up to 10 users, with limits such as a single time clock and no payroll integration.


**Pricing:** The Operations Hub covers the first 30 users on one price: Basic is $29 on annual billing or $35 monthly, Advanced is $49 or $59, and Expert is $99 or $119. Extra users cost $0.80 to $5.00 a month depending on the plan, and each hub is priced separately. A 14-day free trial is available.


**What users like:** One reviewer[said](https://www.g2.com/products/connecteam/reviews_and_filters) it “caters to small businesses,” with a free plan for up to 10 people.


**What users criticize:** Another reviewer[disliked](https://www.g2.com/survey_responses/connecteam-review-4995501) “how expensive it became once we needed more than 10 employees.” A user in an[r/smallbusiness thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/smallbusiness/comments/1refwrc/best_free_scheduling_app_for_employees_what/) said adding test employees pushed them past the free cap into a plan of about $50 a month. G2 reviewers also tag scheduling issues in 300 reviews, against 870 mentions of easy scheduling.


**Our take:** Count every user toward the free cap, including test accounts and managers. Connecteam works best as a Planday alternative when you need field tools like GPS and forms, and it costs more when you add the communications or HR hubs. Our[Connecteam alternatives](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/connecteam-alternatives) guide covers the trade-offs.


### **Sling: Best budget Planday alternative for basic schedules.**


Sling gives you free scheduling for up to 30 users, the highest free cap among these Planday alternatives. Time tracking starts on the paid Premium plan at $2.00 per user per month, and kiosk time tracking and PTO management arrive on Business at $4.00. It’s a solid budget pick if basic schedules cover your needs.


**Best for:** budget-minded teams that need basic schedules and messaging.


**Rating:** G2[4.4](https://www.g2.com/products/sling/reviews) (88 reviews) · Capterra[4.6](https://www.capterra.com/p/142542/Sling/reviews/) (207 reviews)


**What it is:** A scheduling app that Toast customers can also buy through the Toast Shop,[Sling](https://getsling.com/) covers shift scheduling, time-off requests, and team messaging.


**Key features:**


- **Free plan:** shift scheduling, time-off requests, available shifts, news sharing, and private messaging.
- **Premium:** mobile time tracking, labor cost management, overtime tracking, and group messaging.
- **Business:** kiosk time tracking, reports, no-shows, sick call-outs, and PTO management.
- **Fair billing:** paid plans charge only for the people who use the app.


**Pricing:** The free plan covers up to 30 users. Premium is $2.00 per user per month on monthly billing, or $1.70 billed annually, and Business is $4.00, or $3.40 annually. A 15-day trial is available.


**What users like:** A free-plan user[said](https://www.g2.com/products/sling/details) it’s “better than some paid versions of similar apps.”


**What users criticize:** One reviewer[wrote](https://www.g2.com/survey_responses/sling-review-7117767) “Not a lot of team building things in the app other than scheduling.” In the same Reddit thread, one user quit Sling while trying to get it working.


**Our take:** As a budget Planday alternative and staff scheduling software for basic schedules, Sling’s free plan has no time tracking, so you’ll need Premium for a time clock. At 50 users, Premium costs $100 a month on monthly billing. Our[Sling alternatives](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/sling-alternatives) guide compares other budget picks.


## **Which Planday Alternative Fits Your Small Business Team?**


### **Best Planday alternatives by team size.**


Free plans make a real difference below 30 users, so match your headcount to the caps first when you pick a Planday alternative:


- **Under 10 employees:** Homebase Basic, Connecteam’s Small Business Plan, and Findmyshift’s free plan (five team members) all cost $0.
- **10 to 50 employees:** Homebase, When I Work, Sling, and Findmyshift Starter or Business are the Planday alternatives that keep costs low.
- **50 or more employees:** Deputy offers the deepest compliance tools, and Homebase and Findmyshift Business suit teams that care more about flat pricing.


### **Best Planday alternatives by industry.**


The right Planday alternative also depends on what your team does all day:


- **Restaurants:** 7shifts is built for them, and Homebase works for mixed teams that want a time clock and payroll too.
- **Field teams:** Connecteam adds GPS, forms, and quick tasks.
- **Retail and services:** for the best scheduling app for small business teams in these fields, compare Homebase and Deputy on scheduling, time off, and compliance tools.


Rebuilding the schedule from scratch every week costs you your Sunday night. Schedule templates and copy-last-week turn it into a quick edit, and that’s the whole point of[Homebase scheduling](https://www.joinhomebase.com/employee-scheduling) .


## **How to Switch From Planday to Another Scheduling App Without Missing a Shift**


### **Switch scheduling apps at the start of a pay period.**


When you switch from Planday, changing tools mid-period splits an employee’s hours across two systems and complicates payroll. Pick a start date at the beginning of a pay period, announce it two weeks ahead, and finish your setup before it arrives. Our guide to the[best employee scheduling apps](https://www.joinhomebase.com/blog/best-employee-scheduling-apps) can help you shortlist a Planday alternative.


### **Export Planday data before you switch from Planday.**


Planday’s pricing page doesn’t list its export options, so ask Planday support which files you can download and in what format. Save your employee roster, upcoming schedules, and hours history so your new Planday alternative starts with clean data.
